articles.title_en: Struijk sees red but Brighton march on with win against Sunderland
articles.title_ja: Struijk sees red but ブライトン march on with win against Sunderland
articles.summary_ja: ブライトン maintained their excellent start to the new Premier League season, as they beat Sunderland 2-0 at the Stadium of Light, despite having to play much of the second half with ten men, after Pascal Struijk was shown a controversial red card.
